gen-gf-turret-road-gf-antic: Commanding round forms in Turret Road hold the top, drawn like open parentheses with a pen-like line. Antic follows in a contemporary sans-serif, its open letter mouths looking like chalk arcs left unjoined.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads modern, with brush ends lifting away before curves close. Turret Road does its best work as a bold display line of constant weight, while the sans body handles quieter, low-modulation text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-assistant: Bold and unmistakable, Turret Road shapes its letters like open parentheses, earning its keep when set big and brief. Assistant answers in a contemporary sans-serif whose mouths stay open on c, e, and a.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bai-jamjuree: Turret Road draws its round, parenthesis-like forms with a pen-like line, giving headings a commanding, constant-weight presence. Bai Jamjuree is the approachable one, light and unpinched in a plain sans.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-barlow: Barlow reads approachable and contemporary, its c shapes pulled well apart like neon-tube strokes. Turret Road sits above in a display voice, bold round forms drawn with a pen-like constant line.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic opens a wide channel into every bowl, giving a modern, professional plain sans texture. Turret Road is the bolder partner, each stroke holding one thickness like a drawn cable.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-biz-udpgothic: Turret Road gives headings a commanding wire-like line, with round forms that read like open parentheses. BIZ UDPGothic gets lavish letter spacing, so give its size a little extra room to breathe.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bpmf-huninn: Round, bold, and unmistakably display. Bpmf Huninn runs on a single-weight outline feel with a wide channel into every bowl, so extended text stays modern and steady under Turret Road.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Rope-like strokes, bold and round, command the top. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps counters connected to the outside with a restrained swell, so longer stretches feel like soft, hand-drawn ink.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-cairo: Turret Road looks laser-cut, one cutting width throughout. Its bold, commanding display shapes carry the headline, while Cairo, a modern sans-serif with a wide channel into every bowl, handles the body text.
